name: io.github.verbatra/verbatra
title: verbatra
description: Translation status, glossary, and editing tools for a verbatra i18n project, over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: VERBATRA_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to advertise the two provider-calling tools, the same as --allow-spend.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the anthropic provider, read only by the provider-calling tools.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the openai provider, read only by the provider-calling tools.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the gemini provider, read only by the provider-calling tools.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the deepl provider, read only by the provider-calling tools.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the google-translate provider, read only by the provider-calling tools.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the openai-compatible provider, read only by the provider-calling tools.

environmentVariables.name: LIBRETRANSLATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the libretranslate provider, needed only when the server runs with --api-keys, read only by the provider-calling tools.
